steps.title: Gather reagents and consumables
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: glass culture tubes (20 × 150 mm, Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. C1048), 50 mL Falcon tubes, 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes, Saccharomyces cerevisiae W303 strain with 3xFLAG‑V5 bait (e.g., DPY118), 3xFLAG peptide (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. F4799), anti‑FLAG magnetic beads (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. M8823), anti‑V5 magnetic beads (MBL International, cat. M167‑11), 2 % SDS, yeast extract (RPI, cat. Y20020), peptone (RPI, cat. P20240), glucose (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. G8270), dextrose (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. D9434), HEPES (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. H3375), NaCl (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. S7653), Triton X‑100 (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. X100), deoxycholate (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. D6750), EDTA (Sigma‑Aldrich, cat. EDS), cOmplete Mini EDTA‑free protease inhibitor (Roche, cat. 11836170001), liquid nitrogen, dry ice pellets, cryogenic tissue grinder (pre‑chilled at 4 °C), magnetic separation rack, inversion rotating mixer, vortexer, and pipettes/tips.

steps.title: Prepare YPD growth medium
steps.instruction: Combine 1 % yeast extract, 2 % peptone, and 2 % glucose in water; autoclave the mixture, then add sterile glucose after cooling (or filter‑sterilize).

steps.title: Prepare IP lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Make buffer containing 50 mM HEPES pH 8.0, 150 mM NaCl, 1 % Triton X‑100, 0.1 % deoxycholate, 5 mM EDTA, and add 1× cOmplete Mini EDTA‑free protease inhibitor.

steps.title: Inoculate overnight culture
steps.instruction: Add the 3xFLAG‑V5 yeast strain to a glass culture tube with 3 mL YPD medium and incubate overnight at 30 °C, 200 rpm shaking.

steps.title: Dilute and grow to mid‑log phase
steps.instruction: Transfer 2 mL of the overnight culture into a 500 mL flask containing 100 mL fresh YPD; grow at 30 °C, 200 rpm until OD₆₀₀ reaches 0.5–0.8 (≈4 h).

steps.title: Harvest cells and freeze pellets
steps.instruction: Split the culture into two 50 mL Falcon tubes, centrifuge at 4,000 × g for 4 min, discard supernatant, submerge the pellets in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C (up to 3 months).

steps.title: Grind frozen cells with dry ice
steps.instruction: Load dry‑ice pellets into a pre‑chilled (4 °C) cryogenic tissue grinder (or coffee grinder) until the blades are covered; add the frozen yeast pellets and grind for 30 s, repeat five more times (total six grindings), adding dry ice as needed to keep blades covered.

steps.title: Sublimate dry ice and resuspend
steps.instruction: Transfer the pulverized cell/dry‑ice mixture to a beaker, allow dry ice to sublimate at room temperature, then add 1 mL IP lysis buffer, swirl intermittently, and incubate on ice (4 °C) for 5 min to resuspend.

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Move the lysate to a 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube and centrifuge at 20,000 × g for 10 min; keep the supernatant (cleared lysate) and set aside 10 µL for an input Western blot.

steps.title: Bind FLAG‑tagged complexes
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL anti‑FLAG magnetic beads to a fresh 1.5 mL tube, place on a magnetic rack, discard any buffer, wash once with 200 µL lysis buffer, discard wash, then add the cleared lysate and rotate at 4 °C for 2 h on an inversion mixer.

steps.title: Collect unbound fraction
steps.instruction: Place the tube on the magnetic rack until the solution clears (~2 min), take 10 µL for an unbound Western blot, discard the remaining supernatant.

steps.title: Wash FLAG beads
steps.instruction: Perform three washes with 500 µL lysis buffer each: vortex gently, incubate on ice for 5 min, return to magnetic rack, and discard the wash.

steps.title: Elute FLAG complexes
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL lysis buffer containing 100 µg/mL 3xFLAG peptide, incubate on ice for 30 min; repeat once more for a second elution, then pool the two eluates.

steps.title: Bind V5‑tagged complexes
steps.instruction: Add 25 µL anti‑V5 magnetic beads to a new 1.5 mL tube, place on magnetic rack, remove buffer, wash once with 200 µL lysis buffer, discard wash, then add the pooled FLAG eluate and rotate at 4 °C for 2 h on an inversion mixer.

steps.title: Wash V5 beads
steps.instruction: After magnetic separation, discard unbound fraction and wash beads three times with 500 µL lysis buffer; for each wash vortex at half‑max speed for 5 s, incubate on ice 5 min, then discard the wash.

steps.title: Denature final eluate
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL lysis buffer supplemented with 2 % SDS to the beads, heat at 95 °C for 15 min, then place on magnetic rack and collect the supernatant.

steps.title: Prepare samples for analysis
steps.instruction: Take 10 µL of the final eluate for a Western blot (this represents a ~10× concentration relative to input), and keep the remaining 90 µL on ice for submission to a mass‑spectrometry core (e.g., Whitehead Institute Proteomics Facility). Wear gloves, work quickly, and keep samples cold to avoid protease contamination.
